stem: After the summer, Voltmarkt's trading director asks: "How much did clearing out the old laptop models cost us, as a share of laptop sales?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × (1 - laptop net revenue / laptop list value)
100 × clearance markdown euros / laptop net sales
100 × laptop revenue sold on deal / laptop net revenue
100 × (laptop net revenue - cost) / laptop net revenue
